figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Isomerization of allylic alcohol by NsrQ. A) Binary structure of Dcr3 in complex with 3. B) In vitro activities of wild-type NsrQ and its
variants involved in the allylic alcohol isomerization reaction. Residues in the active site were mutated, and an excess amount of NsrK was
introduced in the reaction. The NsrQ-mediated hydrogen transfer activity was calculated based on the remaining NsrK shunt product 7. Triplicate
assays were conducted for quantification. C) Proposed mechanism for Glu121-mediated isomerization of 4 to form 5.

Figure 4. Configurational inversion of 5 by NsrQ. A) Binding mode of 3 in Dcr3. B) In vitro activities of wild-type NsrQ and its variants involved in
the inversion of configuration at C-4 of 5. Data are shown as mean : SEM. Triplicate assays were conducted for quantification. C) Proposed
mechanism for the Glu121-His103-mediated configurational inversion of 5 to form 6.
